color.note: Six grays, every one on the e-ink panel's 16-level ladder (a multiple of #11), so nothing dithers or bands. Night is the whole screen inverted.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Screen and window background: the ground every text color is checked on.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: Graph-paper lines behind the windows (Screen). Decoration only: never text, never a mark that carries meaning.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Title bars, chips, empty wells. Text on it is ink or slate.

tokens.name: fog
tokens.usage: Hard drop shadows, cloud shading, blush on icon faces. Never the only thing telling two states apart (too close to paper).

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Secondary text (lows, rain chances, captions, units) on paper or mist: 7.5:1 and 6.4:1 on Paper, 10.9:1 and 8.3:1 on Night.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, window frames, icon outlines, filled meter segments. On paper, mist, grid and fog.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill: today's row on the days screen, the alert title bar, the primary key. An alias of paper, so it flips with the theme.

groups.name: Numbers
groups.note: Press Start 2P (Google Fonts, OFL): open, blocky arcade digits that stay readable across a room. Every weather value is set here. It is drawn on an 8px grid, so every size is a multiple of 8 and lands on whole screen pixels; one weight only.

styles.name: num-hero
styles.usage: The current temperature. One per screen.

styles.name: num-lg
styles.usage: A secondary big number: inside temperature, a countdown.

styles.name: num-md
styles.usage: Stat values and highs in Forecast. Values of four characters drop to num-sm-plus.

styles.name: num-sm-plus
styles.usage: Lows, and highs that run to four characters (100°, -12°).

styles.name: num-sm
styles.usage: Rain chance and other small values, in slate when secondary.

groups.name: Words
groups.note: Pixelify Sans (Google Fonts, OFL), weights 400 to 700. Words only: the condition, sentences. Never a number you need to read at a glance.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The condition word or screen headline, lowercase.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Dialog headlines and short phrases. Values use num-md, not this.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Sentences: dialog messages, a one-line summary.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Secondary sentences in slate. The smallest reading text.

groups.name: Label
groups.note: Silkscreen (Google Fonts, OFL), an 8px bitmap face: keep it at 16 or 24px so its pixels land whole. Caps only.

styles.name: label-lg
styles.usage: Column headers (day names, hours), key labels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Window titles, stat captions, the status bar and the updated stamp.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, between meter segments.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and keys, between a caption and its value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between rows inside a window.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Window body padding, gap between stat tiles.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Screen margin and the gap between windows.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Breathing room around the hero temperature.

radius.note: Square, like the pixels. The only round things are pills and the title-bar dots.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Windows, tiles, meter segments, keys (keys get their notched corners from shadow-key).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips and the three title-bar dots.

shadow.note: Hard offsets only, no blur: e-ink draws a solid shape crisply and a blur as mud.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Every window: a solid fog block offset down-right, the sticker look.

tokens.name: shadow-key
tokens.usage: Keys (Button): a 2px ink outline with notched pixel corners plus a fog ledge underneath. Use instead of border, never with it.

size.note: Fixed sizes on a 600 × 800 canvas, the Kindle 10th gen panel at 1×. Icons are 16 × 16 art-pixel grids, so they only scale by whole numbers.

tokens.name: canvas-width
tokens.usage: Screen width, portrait. On a Kindle 10th gen this is the panel itself (600 px at 167 ppi): render at 1×. Larger Kindles scale by device width ÷ 600.

tokens.name: canvas-height
tokens.usage: Screen height, 3:4 like every Kindle panel.

tokens.name: grid-cell
tokens.usage: Graph-paper pitch on the Screen background.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Title-bar rule, meter segments, chip outlines, dividers.

tokens.name: border-bold
tokens.usage: Window frames.

tokens.name: icon-xs
tokens.usage: Icons inside chips, keys and rain chances, and the status-bar hearts (1 px per art pixel).

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons in chips, stats and forecast columns (2 px per art pixel).

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons beside a title or in dialogs (4 px per art pixel).

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: The one condition icon next to the hero temperature (8 px per art pixel).
